title: Chapter 09 — Externalities and Public Goods
desc: Negative and positive externalities, Pigouvian taxes and subsidies, the Coase theorem, the four kinds of goods, free riders and the tragedy of the commons.
h1: When the market gets the quantity wrong
intro: A competitive market is efficient only if every cost and benefit falls on the buyer or the seller. When some of it falls on bystanders, or when people can't be made to pay, the market produces the wrong amount.
stats: 4 chunks · 2 live models · 4 checkpoints · 10-question practice exam
